lines.text: You think one airport favour costs you one night.
This guy did three before sunrise. Nobody told him why.
Ding. Now boarding: a man who cannot say no.
Sunday night. Priya texts: airport, four a.m.? Sure.
Ten minutes later, Arjun: four thirty? Fine.
Then Sharma ji. Five sharp, beta. Nobody refuses that moustache.
Three a.m., Rohan gets smart. One car, everyone together.
Three calls. Three phones, already on airplane mode.
Trip one. Priya. Rohan is mostly awake.
Trip two. Arjun. Eyes open. Technically.
Trip three. Sharma ji, and a suitcase the size of a fridge.
Then Priya posts a selfie. Row fourteen.
Seat A, Priya. Seat B, Arjun. Seat C, Sharma ji.
Same flight. Same work trip. Each thought the others booked a cab.
Rohan paid airport parking three times.
Lesson: a favour asked in private gets driven three times.
So the colony made a pool on an app. Airport runs too.
Next trip, three taps on ready from the gate. One car.
Petrol and parking? Settle costs splits it four ways.
Now every Sunday night, Rohan's phone hits airplane mode first.
Airport runs eating your sleep? Sahyatri. Link in bio.
